name: signal-scoring
description: Score and prioritize prospects using buying signals — hiring, funding, tech stack changes, executive moves, and intent data. Use when the user wants to score leads, prioritize outreach, detect buying intent, rank prospects, or find the hottest accounts. Triggers on: "score leads", "prioritize", "signals", "buying intent", "trigger events", "who should we contact first", "lead scoring", "signal detection", "intent data", or any request to rank prospects by readiness-to-buy.
